name: Having a HARD Time
source:
You're a sophomore at Wentford University, majoring in Chemistry alongside your life-long best friend. You've been living a fairly normal and carefree life until one day an after class science experiment turns into a freak accident, changing your life as you know it. How will you deal with the cards that life has dealt you? How do you respond to these newfound difficulties? And how will your relationships with those around you change from now on?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/QuadrupleQ]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是Wentford大学的大二学生，和从小最要好的朋友一起主修化学。你一直过着平凡而无忧无虑的生活，直到某天，一场课后的科学实验引发离奇事故，将熟悉的人生彻底改变。面对命运发给你的这手牌，你会如何应对？你将怎样面对这些突如其来的困难？从此，你与周围人的关系又会发生怎样的变化？

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/QuadrupleQ]Patreon[/url]]
